explication: This repository is educational code for building, training, and adapting GPT-like language models from scratch. A principal workflow moves from text preparation and model construction to pretraining, then fine-tuning and generation or evaluation; classification is a separate fine-tuning outcome. The code also covers model variants, distributed training, and LoRA. The README establishes these broad stages, while sampled files show particular implementations and interfaces. Many chapter modules were not sampled, so edges between those subsystems are limited to documented relationships.
